comment: The Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak's last boss's tail (BNpcBase 266): 1278 HP, level 24, there from its 702 at 55 % until it's killed; it never acted in either run. For 364, 345 and 1014, which only poison, the recorded amount is the poison's tick (retail's ActionEffect gives it with the status). From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak (2026-10-30): one run with Duty Support (caa5e908, visit 0.15) and one Duty Finder run (1fac2416, visit 0.15), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the two runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
